header: VEHICLE ABANDONMENT NOTICE AND REMOVAL AUTHORIZATION

blocks.text: VEHICLE ABANDONMENT NOTICE AND REMOVAL AUTHORIZATION

This Vehicle Abandonment Notice is issued by {{property_owner_name}} ("Property Owner" / "Landlord") on {{notice_date}} to {{vehicle_owner_name}} ("Vehicle Owner") regarding Vehicle: {{vehicle_make}} {{vehicle_model}} {{vehicle_year}}, VIN: {{vehicle_vin}}, License Plate: {{license_plate}}.
Property Owner hereby notifies Vehicle Owner that the Vehicle located at {{vehicle_location}} is believed to have been abandoned, based on the following grounds:

rows: Vehicle has been stationary / not moved for more than {{abandonment_period}} consecutive days
Vehicle appears to be inoperable, disabled, or wrecked
Vehicle has expired registration or license plate
Vehicle has no insurance or expired insurance
Vehicle is causing a nuisance, hazard, or obstruction
Vehicle is on private property without permission
{{no_permission_details}} (Permission was granted until: {{permission_end_date}} — Permission was revoked on: {{permission_revoked_date}})

blocks.text: Property Owner demands that Vehicle Owner immediately remove the Vehicle from {{vehicle_location}} within {{removal_deadline}} days of this notice (by {{removal_deadline_date}}). If Vehicle Owner fails or refuses to remove the Vehicle within this time period, Property Owner may take the following actions:

items: Tow the Vehicle from the property at Vehicle Owner's expense, using a licensed towing company. Vehicle Owner will be responsible for all towing, storage, and related costs.
Store the Vehicle at a storage facility. Vehicle Owner will be responsible for all storage fees, which will accrue daily until the Vehicle is removed.
Sell, dispose of, or otherwise dispose of the Vehicle in accordance with applicable state law, after providing any required notices and after any required holding period.
Charge Vehicle Owner for any damages caused by the Vehicle to the property.
Take any other action permitted by applicable law.

rows: {{estimated_storage_cost}} per day — Estimated daily storage from: {{storage_start_date}}
Vehicle Owner's Right to Retrieve Vehicle
{{right_to_retrieve}} (Vehicle Owner may retrieve the Vehicle at any time before it is sold or disposed of, upon payment of all towing, storage, and related fees)

blocks.text: This notice is provided in accordance with {{state_abandonment_law}} (State law regarding abandoned vehicles on private property). Vehicle Owner is advised to consult with an attorney regarding their rights and obligations. Nothing in this notice waives any rights or obligations of Property Owner or Vehicle Owner under applicable law.

rows: {{required_notice_period}} days (State law requires at least {{required_notice_period}} days notice before towing or disposing of an abandoned vehicle)
{{required_notice_contents}} (State law requires the notice to include: description of the vehicle, location, date of notice, deadline to remove, and consequences of failure to remove)
Vehicle Owner Acknowledgment of Receipt (if received)
